run_evaluation_3d_pose: run evaluation on a trained model to compute MPJPE and reconstruction error on Human3.6M or 3DPW datasets
run_evaluation_from_pickle: run evaluation by loading predictions from pickle files instead of running the model forward pass
run_evaluation_mask_part: run evaluation on LSP dataset to compute mask accuracy and part segmentation F1 scores
run_evaluation_save_results: run evaluation and save predicted joints, pose, betas, and camera parameters to an npz file
run_evaluation_ablation_study: run evaluation comparing different model ablation experiments using pickle output directories for 3DPW dataset
